in_sanskrit.name: सन्जिता
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has conquered, or has attained victory

in_marathi.name: Sanjita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Born of Goddess Durga
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sanjita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sanjita is derived from the Sanskrit language, it is a combination of two words ‘San’ meaning born and ‘Jita’ meaning victory. It signifies that a girl named Sanjita is born of Goddess Durga, and she is a victorious one. This name signifies strength, courage, and resilience.
